basis: Deming and Kahn (2018) inspired ten-category analytical layer; customer service and project management are combined; AI is explicit.

categories.name: Cognitive skill
categories.definition: Reasoning, analysis, problem solving, and quantitative thinking.

categories.name: Social skill
categories.definition: Communication, collaboration, negotiation, and interpersonal interaction.

categories.name: Character skill
categories.definition: Reliability, adaptability, initiative, persistence, and self-regulation.

categories.name: Writing skill
categories.definition: Writing, editing, documentation, and written communication.

categories.name: Customer and project management
categories.definition: Customer service, project planning, delivery, and stakeholder coordination.

categories.name: People management
categories.definition: Supervision, coaching, hiring, delegation, and team leadership.

categories.name: Financial skill
categories.definition: Accounting, budgeting, financial analysis, and financial controls.

categories.name: General computer skill
categories.definition: General digital literacy, office computing, data handling, and computer use.

categories.name: Specific software skill
categories.definition: Named software, programming languages, platforms, and technical tools.

categories.name: AI skill
categories.definition: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, and related tools or methods.

mapping_policy: A source concept may remain unmapped when evidence is insufficient. Do not force every ESCO or O*NET concept into an analytical category. Mapping changes require versioning and review.
